title: fix(state): surface the renewal failure behind "state lease heartbeat exited"
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fatal renewal errors inside the state lease heartbeat Worker are discarded before exit, leaving Doctor and maintenance failures with only `state lease heartbeat exited`.

This is diagnostic coverage, **not a claimed fix for the original CI flake**. The two unexplained failures were [run 35588763964, job 106298641070](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35588763964/job/106298641070) and [run 35589020413, job 106300350018](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35589020413/job/106300350018). The second failed the required-Doctor-step refusal case; its detection-refusal case passed. Their 579 ms / 600 ms durations cannot be explained by ordinary expiry of the 60-second lease. Prior investigation had zero unforced reproductions.

## User Impact

When the Worker can report a fatal renewal error, heartbeat exits retain its name, message, SQLite code/extended code, attempt number, elapsed milliseconds since acquisition, acquisition timestamp, and last successful Worker renewal (or `never`). Abrupt exits also include the exit code and shared renewal timestamp. Lease admission, expiry, contention retries, cleanup, schemas, configuration, and update behavior are unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing Worker sends its fatal error fields before teardown; the host reconstructs an Error cause and includes the details in its exit message. One additional shared-memory timestamp records committed Worker renewals even when a crash prevents an error message. Acquisition time comes from the existing grant's expiry minus its lease duration and survives heartbeat handoffs. The formatted diff adds 61 net production lines and no new owner or cache; the lease owner reuses its canonical identity type and shrinks by two lines.

## Evidence

Final [CI run 35612354677](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35612354677) completed successfully for head `9bc55a9ed9f996bd150a7a08637d82466e7f8380`, including both previously failing test shards. Squash auto-merge completed on September 21, 2026 at 15:04 UTC as `28acdfc4504d43403ffa83c5090d260f27d636c1`. The CLI auto-merge command was refused by string-rewrite protection; the authorized GraphQL `enablePullRequestAutoMerge` path succeeded.

Before: the new diagnostic tests fail against unchanged production code because the error cause, expiry distinction, and exit diagnostics are absent. After: the seven cases pass, including failure before and after renewal, expiry, four contention codes, and abrupt exits. A real Worker/SQLite trigger regression also checks the public lease rejection and row cleanup. No throughput improvement is claimed for this diagnostic lane.

Runtime proof covers 112 distinct tests across 11 files, including both original refusal cases. Final-source revalidation passed the 13 diagnostic/startup cases plus the real-Worker fault (684 ms). Core production typechecking and all 24 core test typecheck graphs passed; the latter took 1,485.88 seconds. Fresh Codex autoreview found no actionable P0–P2 findings. The original CI fault remains unreproduced; hard crashes cannot provide a renewal error they never posted.

CI follow-up: [the first PR run's backup shard](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35605976556/job/106353571281) expected one opaque-link warning but received two. The exact 23-file shard replay passed, so it did not reproduce that event. A controlled foreign tokenless backup scratch directory in the ambient temporary directory reproduced the same assertion with a legacy-scratch warning plus the expected symlink warning. Giving the existing fixture its own `TMPDIR` passed the identical proof with every warning/archive/restore assertion retained; assertion failures now include warning text. This repairs fixture input isolation. The original log omitted the second warning's text, and a possible production race inspecting active scratch before acquiring its token remains a separate follow-up.

The [second run's cron failure](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35609394108/job/106365053433) had already been repaired on main by [dba638a954f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dba638a954fdec8b1ecb4ac8644a6c8eff4c390c), the immediate child of that run's base. The branch incorporates that verified existing fix: the fixture joins actual coalesced heartbeat completion within its unchanged 10-second budget instead of racing a one-second retry with a one-second polling assertion. No additional cron implementation was added here. The owned PR patch is identical across the base refresh (stable patch ID `4d9cea58536994ac5300430a9ba97cf3b6a71aeb`); the refreshed tree differs from the failed CI merge tree only by that existing cron test repair.

All heavy validation ran through the installed Crabbox CLI with provider `blacksmith-testbox`, profile `openclaw-check`; one lease/command was active at a time. The Mac ran no tests, typechecks, or builds.

<details>
<summary>Testbox commands, timings, and recovery history</summary>

The original lease was `tbx_01m31yt17z97cqetkk6q1z8f60` ([Testbox run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35599383831)); it was stopped after two checksum-sync timeouts before test execution. Recovery lease `tbx_01m31zen3yn1azda1vcd509937` ([Testbox run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35600472359)) was later replaced after the same sync timeout. Final validation uses `tbx_01m32030vxfnmyw17f61my7354` ([Testbox run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35601557000)). All synced the same base `9e61c5e3a19afd0740e74cce2c679b1575a66dac` plus this candidate. Each needed one frozen dependency install in its isolated synced checkout.

| Remote command (after `crabbox run --id <lease> --timing-json --`) | Result |
| --- | --- |

| Original lease: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/state/openclaw-state-lease src/infra/state-migrations.caller-mode.refusal.test.ts src/infra/gateway-owner-lease.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` | 56 tests / five files passed; 75.35 s wrapper wall. Includes both previously failing refusal cases. The wrapper's filename filter did not select the hyphenated heartbeat/acquisition/contention files, which were run explicitly next. |

The first real-Worker fixture installed its trigger too early and schema validation rejected it before acquisition. Fixed by bracketing injection between acquisition and Worker exit. |

Reused the canonical identity type and pinned the lane base for the final gate. |
| Recovery lease: `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --base 9e61c5e3a19afd0740e74cce2c679b1575a66dac --timed -- <eight changed files>` | Guards passed, then core typecheck caught the Worker error-event's `unknown` type. Fixed with the existing error normalizer. The corrected rerun timed out in checksum sync before execution, so the lease was stopped. |
| Final lease: the same pinned `check-changed` command | All guards, core production typecheck, 24 test typecheck graphs, and dead-export scans passed. Lint caught the missing explicit empty `postMessage` transfer list; corrected to match the existing readiness message. Reused the completed test typechecks after this mechanical fix. |
| Final lease: `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig tsconfig.core.json <eight changed files>`, then `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo` | Passed. Lint: zero errors and the existing 703-line warning on the lease owner (down from 705); growth ratchet passes. |
| Final lease: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/state/openclaw-state-lease-heartbeat.diagnostics.test.ts src/state/openclaw-state-lease-heartbeat.startup.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` | 13 passed; 25.27 s wrapper / 23.16 s Vitest wall, including 19.15 s cold Worker compilation. |
| Final lease: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/state/openclaw-state-lease-heartbeat.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 -t 'preserves a native renewal error'` | One passed (684 ms), 16 intentionally unselected previously passing cases; 10.28 s wrapper / 8.27 s Vitest wall. |
| Final lease: `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json <eight changed files>` (the canonical changed-check lint configuration) | Passed, zero errors; same existing size warning. 50.1 s lint wall, exit 0. |

Explicit six-file set: `src/state/openclaw-state-lease-heartbeat.diagnostics.test.ts`, `src/state/openclaw-state-lease-heartbeat.startup.test.ts`, `src/state/openclaw-state-lease-heartbeat.test.ts`, `src/state/openclaw-state-lease-heartbeat.source-cwd.test.ts`, `src/state/openclaw-state-lease-acquisition.test.ts`, and `src/state/openclaw-state-lease-contention.test.ts`.

Final core typechecking, canonical lint, focused regressions, formatting, and `git diff --check` passed. All three leases were stopped and reported `completed`. No full runtime suite was run. The completed 24-graph test typecheck was reused after adding the explicit empty transfer list; the production typecheck and affected runtime/lint proof were rerun.

<details>
<summary>Backup fixture CI repair proof</summary>

Provider `blacksmith-testbox`, profile `openclaw-check`, lease `tbx_01m3236y742fnt1va9sebv0kqe` ([run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35607254766)). Reproduction used an isolated remote worktree at the exact failed CI merge revision `fb32bc556766d393e186c450edd758bd4f6405f8`, with frozen dependencies, the captured `core-runtime-infra-diagnostics-state` manifest, and two Vitest workers. The Mac ran no tests.

- Original shard replay: 351 tests / 23 files passed, 122.98 s Vitest wall. Added warning text to the assertion only; no unforced reproduction.
- Controlled ambient-scratch proof: the unchanged fixture failed with exactly two identified warnings; the same case with fixture-owned scratch passed in 440 ms. Disposable injection was removed.
- Repaired original shard: 351 tests / 23 files passed, 53.41 s Vitest wall.
- `pnpm test src/infra/backup-create.opaque-links.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: three tests passed, 6.61 s wrapper / 5.18 s Vitest wall; test bodies totaled 343 ms.
- Final PR CI also passed the three backup fixture cases: 256 ms, 8 ms, and 186 ms (450 ms total test-body time).
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/infra/backup-create.opaque-links.test.ts`: zero warnings/errors, 38.1 s.
- Repeat validation passed: 20/20 standalone file runs and 3/3 repaired original-shard runs (351 tests each). The additional 19 standalone runs plus two shard replays used one sequential Crabbox invocation, exit 0 in 344.447 s including sync. The final two shard wrappers took 58.24 s and 63.66 s.
- Fresh Codex autoreview: no actionable P0–P2 findings. The repair adds no production code, mocks, sleeps, retries, or weaker assertions.
- The repair lease was stopped and reported `completed`; all four task leases are stopped.

</details>
